text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with

Matikanefukukitaru...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Look over there, Trainer! What else
could that be
but a lucky omen!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару points toward a claw
machine
filled with Umamusume
plushies.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Today's horoscope said my lucky item is
a plushie!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
The great Shiraoki wanted this
encounter to
happen, guiding me here
to this very spot!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I just know super-ultra-mega-great
fortune will
come my way if a certain
lucky trainer wins one
for me!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Of course! I have great faith that you'll
reel in a
whole bunch!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I can see it already! You'll be hauling
them in by
the boatload! You'll be the
envy of all the other
trainers!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Теперь я ни за что не могу подвести!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
